name: Do I need special permits for accessible furniture space planning in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Do I need special permits for accessible furniture space planning in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accessible furniture space planning itself generally does not require special permits, as it primarily involves interior arrangement and non-structural changes. However, if the planning leads to structural modifications like widening doorways or reconfiguring walls, or significant plumbing/electrical work, then building permits from the City of Daly City planning department would be required. It’s always best to consult with your contractor regarding specific project needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are usually not needed for furniture arrangement, but are required for structural changes like widening doorways or major utility work.
